verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents a self-hosted Edge Proxy that runs an instance of the Flagsmith Engine in your own infrastructure. Server-side SDKs connect to it, which satisfies the story's 'edge/relay layer' option. The docs place it 'close to your servers' rather than at the user edge, and only server-side SDK connectivity is described. Missing for 10: CDN worker/edge-runtime evaluation support, evidence of deployment close to end users or of client-side SDKs using the proxy, and independent hands-on corroboration of the Edge Proxy.
